column1: # polyglot18 — 18 aider-polyglot tasks, 3 per language, selected for DIVERSE
# knowledge axes rather than coverage of the 225-task pool. Used to source
# Tier-B agentic PASS traces for the v7-coder targeting map.
# Selection rule: within each language, pick three tasks on three DIFFERENT
# knowledge axes, preferring the task that most exercises that language's own
# idioms (rust ownership, java generics, js async, go error handling ...). A
# coder expert map wants breadth of competence, not repetitions of one axis.
